assessment: Your unbiased analysis of T cell motion in different tissue settings has revealed that many parameters of T cell motion are similar across tissues, whereas other parameters, particularly related to confinement, are highly sensitive to the tissue microenvironment. Your agnostic approach, meticulous analysis, and clear results are valuable and the technical approach is convincing in its simplicity. The work will be of interest to scientists working in diverse fields from immunologists tracking white blood cell motion to developmental biologists tracking germ cells in Drosophila larvae.
